title: biarum bovei subsp. haenseleri
intro: Biarum bovei subsp. haenseleri, commonly known as the Haensel's lily or Egyptian voodoo lily, is a species of flowering plant in the family Colchicaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor properties. The therapeutic actions of Biarum bovei subsp. haenseleri include wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic properties due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
